title: Redact secrets before logging
instruction: redact(value) in src/redact.mjs prepares data for logs. Return a deep copy in which the value of any property whose key, compared case-insensitively after removing '-' and '_', is one of password, secret, token, apikey, authorization, cookie, setcookie is replaced by '[REDACTED]', at any depth, inside arrays too. Additionally, in every string value replace 'Bearer <token>' (case-insensitive 'bearer', token of [A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]+) with 'Bearer [REDACTED]'. Do not mutate the input. Handle circular references by replacing the repeated object with '[Circular]'. Non-plain values other than arrays and plain objects are returned as-is.

acceptanceCriteria: sensitive keys redacted at any depth and in arrays
